description: Read-only XRPL ledger header and metadata lookup. Omit `ledger_index` to use the current validated ledger, or provide a validated ledger index/selector to pin the lookup; set `transactions=true` to include that ledger's transactions and use `expand=true` to return those transactions as full objects. The result provides ledger metadata and, when requested, transaction data without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for ledger headers, metadata, and optional ledger transactions; use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data instead when you need raw ledger-state objects.

expand.description: Whether returned transactions should be expanded into full transaction objects.
expand.title: Expand

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or ledger selector. Omit to use the current validated ledger.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

transactions.description: Whether to include transactions contained in the requested ledger.
transactions.title: Transactions

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger
